# SMS and Voice Support in Sandbox

Source: https://developers.webexconnect.io/reference/sms-and-voice-support-in-sandbox
Documentation version: 6.20.0
Retrieved: 2026-09-08T23:31:40+00:00

While in Webex Connect, we support outbound messaging and voice in 200+ countries and two-way SMS and Voice in 85+ countries overall, In Sandbox mode, the support for SMS and Voice channels is limited to following countries:

**Countries supported in Sandbox**

| Country            | Outbound SMS | Inbound SMS | Outbound Voice | Inbound Voice |
| :----------------- | :----------- | :---------- | :------------- | :------------ |
| United States      | YES          | YES         | YES            | YES           |
| Canada             | YES          | YES         | YES            | YES           |
